name: Savina de Ses Salines

location.address: Ses Salines Natural Park, Cavall d'en Borras dune area, roughly 250 m from Ses Illetes beach

access: Free. Stands inside the Ses Salines Natural Park on the dune track between La Savina port and Ses Illetes beach; a public coastal footpath (also used by cyclists) passes the dune area, and vehicle access to the wider area is restricted in summer to protect the park.
transport: Ferry from Ibiza Town to La Savina port on Formentera (about 25-35 minutes), then roughly 20-30 minutes on foot or by bike along the coastal dune path towards Ses Illetes.
verify_notes: Register fitxa (CAIB) and periodicodeibiza.es (2022) survey independently agree: over 500 years old, 'segurament la savina mes vella de les Balears' (likely the oldest sabina/juniper in the Balearics), height 7.5 m, crown diameter 12 m, trunk diameter 94 cm ('nearly 3 m in circumference' per source, matches 94 x pi = approx 295 cm, used as girth_cm). Age given only as 'over 500 years' by both sources, a vague figure repeated as given per BRIEF_RESEARCH.md rule (not sharpened to a number); age_max left empty since no upper bound is stated anywhere. Ownership conflict noted: our register import lists holder as MITECO/MITERD (COSTES, the Spanish coastal authority) while the CAIB fitxa itself names the owner as Salinera Espanola SA (the historic salt company); recording both rather than picking a winner. Regardless of formal ownership, the tree sits inside the Ses Salines Natural Park on a public coastal path confirmed via search (path parallels the shore from south of Cavall d'en Borras beach to La Savina port, walkable/cyclable, part of the route toward Ses Illetes, one of Formentera's best known beaches), so public accessibility is well evidenced. Catalogued as a singular tree 11 June 1993. Isolated growth (no competing vegetation) noted as the reason for its unusually large dimensions.
